technical.summary: Strong bullish structure with price above all MAs and multiple bullish indicators, but extreme overbought conditions (RSI 80+, Stoch 95) and lack of fresh crossover signals limit swing entry probability; better suited for profit-taking or pullback entry.

fundamental.summary: BWA shows no insider buying, no institutional accumulation, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 90 days—insufficient smart money conviction to support a trade.

sentiment.summary: No actionable congressional signal; broad market neutral sentiment with slight bearish bias (47% bearish vs 25% bullish) offers modest contrarian opportunity, but lack of recent news data limits conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (271.68) indicates extreme market stress, CPI event just occurred, and Consumer Discretionary sector faces demand destruction in recessionary environment.

debate.key_bull_argument: Strong bullish technical structure (price above all MAs, supertrend bullish, three white soldiers, Ichimoku above cloud) with RSI 9 extreme overbought suggests momentum continuation if breakout holds.
debate.key_bear_argument: Extreme overbought conditions (RSI 80+, Stoch 95.11, Williams %R overbought) combined with zero fundamental conviction, severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis levels), and lack of fresh crossover signals create high probability of mean reversion into support rather than swing continuation.

decision.entry_rationale: Technical structure is bullish with price above all MAs and supertrend confirmation, but extreme overbought conditions (RSI 80+, Stoch 95.11) at resistance create unfavorable risk/reward for swing entry.
decision.primary_risk: Severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis levels 271.68) combined with zero fundamental conviction and Consumer Discretionary sector recession vulnerability make mean reversion highly probable.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bearish bias despite technical strength
decision.portfolio_note: Already holding BWA position; adding to existing Consumer Discretionary concentration (6 positions) during macro crisis and earnings proximity (90 days) violates prudent risk management.
